title: Electrostatic constant value
description: Essential: Student must provide the correct numerical value for k: 9.0 × 10⁹.

title: Gravitational constant unit
description: Essential: Student must correctly write the SI unit for G: N·m²/kg².

title: Mass calculation
description: Essential: Student must provide the final mass value: 1.2 × 10¹⁰ kg.

title: Force equation setup
description: Important: Student must set up both force equations (Coulomb's law and Newton's law) and equate them.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Important: Student must correctly solve the equation m = √(k/G) from the equality of forces.

title: Significant figures
description: Important: Student must present all final answers with exactly two significant figures.

title: Unit omission in mass
description: Pitfall: Student provides the numerical value for mass without the correct unit (kg).

title: Incorrect square root handling
description: Pitfall: Student makes an algebraic error, such as writing m = k/G instead of m = √(k/G).

title: Given constant misuse
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses the provided value √(1/6.67) = 0.387, perhaps by substituting it for G or k directly.
